name: rulereceipt
description: Check whether your agent followed your CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md rules. Adds a rulereceipt skill and /rulereceipt:check, :doctor, :report, :audit, :why, :health commands that read the finished session locally and report each rule as followed, broken (with the quoted line as proof), or needs-human-judgment. Installs NO hooks, writes nothing to settings, and sends no telemetry — it reports after the fact and blocks nothing. It calls the rulereceipt CLI pinned to an exact version (npx fetches it if missing); it never auto-wires anything.
